facts: Study the intact neutral C20H30O3 ketoester pair obtained by inversion only at atom map 6 of `50_graph`; retain all other stereocenters. The supplied `enol_TMS` graph defines the intervening tetrasubstituted O-TMS enol ether. Preparation uses HMDS (2.0 equiv) and TMSI (1.4 equiv) in CH2Cl2 at 23 °C for 30 min, followed in a second pot by racemic camphorsulfonic acid (1.0 equiv) at 23 °C for 30 min. The supplied records disagree on the THF/MeOH volume ratio (1:1 versus 10:1); declare the interpretation and model medium used. Observed reversible epimerization returns trans material, whereas the two-pot sequence gives a 1.1:1 trans:cis mixture. Three recycling rounds give 70% isolated cis material. These are known observations to explain. Full synthesis, acid screening, exact yields and identification of a unique protonation transition state are outside scope.
scope: Local ketoester epimerization and the supplied two-pot sequence only.
